2) Helm chart sidecars: we currently inject a health-check sidecar for the keystone proxy. For the rehearsal we will run without the sidecar; that requires a specific serviceAccount binding change on your cluster (described below).

Proposed plan (high level):
- Wed 06/30 09:00 PT: Preflight checklist run (we will drive).
- Wed 06/30 11:00 PT: Staged apply on ACME staging environment (canary subset).
- Wed 06/30 13:00 PT: Simulated cert rotation + automated smoke tests.
- Wed 06/30 14:30 PT: Rollback / validate drift detection + evidence bundle collection.

Checklist snapshot: (we'll share PDF)
- Provider access & short-lived lock: confirmed
- Helm values pinned for keystone proxy: confirmed
- Network policy permits probe traffic between canary pods: confirmed
- Audit logging turned on for apply actions: confirmed

I've attached a draft "rehearsal-playbook.md" and our IaC checklist; please review and update the access bits on your side.

- Helm: we've prepared two values sets — one with the health-check sidecar (default) and one without (rehearsal). Chart version 2.9.1 includes the sidecar toggle under values.keystone.sidecar.enabled.

- Ansible: the post-apply evidence collection is an ansible playbook that zips logs and pushes the artifact to the drive link. We'll run ansible from our ephemeral bastion; you'll see an ephemeral role ARN in the preflight step.

Operational ask for ACME: please confirm that the staging cluster allows our runner's ephemeral role to create serviceAccount bindings in the kube-system namespace (we scope it tightly — limited time window, auditable). If not OK, we'll adapt with a manual step in the playbook but it will lengthen the rehearsal by ~25 minutes.
